scope: Existing C context21 portfolios only; inherited contribution values, no new demand/calendar/allocation optimization
resource_gate: working labels<=4; one common hypothetical reserve
closed_parameters: F>=0 same incremental weekly charge per modeled aircraft including one reserve; B>=0 incremental weekly newbase charge; external donor and other excluded terms equal across compared alternatives
limitations: These assumptions define relative choice among enumerated actions, not complete PnL. Actual F/B/O are UNKNOWN. If actual donor/other-cost differences differ, append their signed difference to the inequalities.
keep: KEEP delta=0 is retained as economic comparator outside the required action-only route-count problem; it dominates negative adjustments under zero external donor gain/nonnegative extra costs, but company profit UNKNOWN
method: Pairwise affine halfplanes; direct coefficient dominance certificates for inactive candidates; nonnegative feasible witness for every active candidate verified against every alternative
not_claimed: comparison of annual Nastya money to weekly C
